Pay a tax to the king

options: In the house of his gods
In a storehouse by the river

questions.answer: all the kingdoms of the earth

options: The exiles who returned from Babylon to Judah

options: They could not find their genealogy records

options: Eat of the most holy things

questions.answer: set it up in its place

wrong: for they were born in Babylon

Cyrus sent them from his forests

options: They had seen the first house
They were not allowed to help

options: To let them help build the temple

They blocked the road from Lebanon

They would make an alliance with Egypt
They would crown their own king

They feared the Jews would attack them
The king had asked them to report

Zerubbabel refuses their help
A letter is sent to Artaxerxes
Work on God's house stops

options: Who gave you a decree to build this house?
Why have you rebelled against Darius?
How much tribute will you pay?
Where did you get this timber?

options: The eye of their God was on the elders

questions.q: Why did the elders say their fathers' temple had been destroyed?
options: Their fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath
The Assyrians had burned it by chance
The Persians had torn it down

questions.q: The elders answered, "We are the servants of ____."
questions.answer: the God of heaven and earth

questions.q: Tattenai reported that the house was being built with great stones and ____.

Zerubbabel and Jeshua begin to build
Tattenai questions the builders
Tattenai writes to Darius

Tattenai's letter said the work was going slowly and failing.

options: Cyrus' decree to build God's house

options: At Achmetha in the province of Media

questions.q: Who did Darius say must pay the building expenses?
options: The king's goods, from the tribute beyond the River
The Jews who returned from exile

The fall of the king's enemies

The exiles keep the Passover

options: A skilled scribe in the law of Moses
A captain of the king's army

options: The LORD his God's hand was on him
Ezra paid the king in gold

options: Priests, Levites, and servants of God's house

questions.answer: the good hand of his God

Artaxerxes' letter to Ezra is copied

The king had already refused once
He did not trust the Persian soldiers
The soldiers were needed at war

options: Weighed them into the hands of chosen priests
Gave them to the king's governors

The people had stopped building the temple
The priests had stolen the silver
The people had broken the Sabbath

questions.q: How did Ezra react when he heard the report?
options: He tore his garments and pulled out his hair and beard
He called for the guilty to be stoned

questions.q: Who gathered to Ezra as he sat confounded?
options: Everyone who trembled at God's words

options: Punished them less than they deserved
Punished them exactly as they deserved
Not yet punished them at all

items: The princes report the mixed marriages
Ezra tears his garment and sits confounded
Ezra kneels at the evening offering
Ezra confesses the people's guilt

options: To put away the foreign wives and their children
To rebuild the walls of Jerusalem
To send the guilty back to Babylon

options: Losing possessions and being separated from the assembly

questions.q: Why were the people trembling as they sat before God's house?
options: Because of this matter and the great rain
Because of a threat from Samaria
Because the king had sent soldiers

items: Shecaniah proposes a covenant
Ezra makes the leaders swear
The people gather in the rain

Everyone in the assembly agreed to the plan without anyone opposing it.
